sections.text_helper: Section 16 "System configuration controller (SYSCFG)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 808.
sections.section_content:
STM32N6x5/x7xx devices feature a set of configuration registers. The SYSCFG manages:
• Cortex-M55 internal settings (such as TCM, CACHE, or vectors)
• interconnect, security, and memory settings
• compensation cells
